purpose: Decide the next generative representation and expose data/contact evidence gaps after the frozen mixture-Transformer hard stop.
scope: Read the already acquired train-only CMU corpus. Audit metadata coverage, heuristic foot-contact sensitivity, and exact reconstruction through the retained 23-joint hierarchy. Do not fit a model or change the add-on runtime.

contact_pseudo_label.decision_rule: Treat every result as a weak pseudo-label estimate. Sensitivity or plausible aggregate rates do not upgrade it to ground truth or a hard contact constraint.

hierarchy.selection: Smallest eligible train-only clip for each of the 85 subjects.

CMU.reason: Already acquired with provenance; broad action coverage but weak style/contact/scene labels.

100STYLE.reason: CC BY 4.0 locomotion-style supplement with 100 styles and more than four million frames, but one actor and a different 28-bone topology do not cover contacts, scene interaction, or full action diversity.

LAFAN1.reason: Publisher labels the dataset CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

AMASS.reason: The free license prohibits commercial use and training commercial neural networks.

representation_hypothesis.generative_state: Root translation and heading plus ancestor-local rotations over the complete retained hierarchy, fixed offsets/proportions, velocities, contact probabilities, support/scene context, intent/style, authored masks, and confidence.
representation_hypothesis.constraint_state: The existing 17 semantic controls remain the rig-neutral animator constraint and evaluation surface.
representation_hypothesis.postprocess: Exact authored-control projection, FK, joint limits, contact locking, collision, balance, gravity/momentum refinement, then validation on the original rig.
representation_hypothesis.rejection: Do not train another nearby world-space selector/Transformer/loss-weight variant.
